    rng = gsl_qrng.gsl_qrng_alloc(dimension)
    result = np.zeros((count, dimension), dtype=np.float64)
    gsl_qrng.generate_sobol_sequence(rng, ctypes.byref(result[0, 0]), dimension, count)

    def heapify(array, n, i, compare):
        largest = i
        left = 2 * i + 1
        right = 2 * i + 2
        if left < n and compare(array[left], array[largest]):
            largest = left
        if right < n and compare(array[right], array[largest]):

            heapify(array, n, largest)

    for i in range(n):
